Name: Sebastian Abigail and Farmer Polyamory Events
Author: zoedoll
Description:
[b][size=5][size=5][b]Updated for 1.6 by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]Airyn[/url]!

Due to IRL stuff I am on a modding hiatus - I have enough time to answer comments and upload bugfixes or updates that other people give me, but not to update mods myself or add new features. While most of my mods should remain compatible with 1.6 there may be some issues I won't be able to address until I have time to mod again.[/b][/size][/size][/b]

My first mod!

Adds events if you're dating Sebastian and Abigail at the same time and are using Keep Your Partners or Multiple Spouses so don't intend to break up with either of them any time soon, and some bonus dialogue if you're married to both of them.

This is not a Rival Hearts mod as it only directly talks about both Abigail and Sebastian being in a relationship with the farmer, not each other, but it does talk about Abigail and Sebastian having crushes on each other. The 8 heart event will still trigger if you're using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners & Friendships[/url], but I'm assuming if you're downloading this you haven't set either of them to platonic! Both events should still trigger if you're married to one of them and then hit 8/10 hearts with the other one, as long as you saw their 10H event before marrying them.

[u]Events:[/u]

[b]First event (Eight Hearts):[/b]
[spoiler]Go to Sebastian's room on a Thursday between midday and 7pm[/spoiler]
[b]
Second event (Ten Hearts):[/b]
[spoiler]After seeing both their Ten Heart events you will get a letter from Abigail telling you to meet them in her room after 6pm[/spoiler]

[b]Third event:[/b]
[spoiler]Date night! In summer, you'll get a letter from Abigail asking you to go to Sebastian's place to watch some movies. There's a choice of what movie to watch, but it doesn't impact your relationship points.[/spoiler]

[u]Configuration:
[/u]check "true" if you're married to both Sebastian and Abigail (using something like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6227]Multiple Spouses[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url]) in order to unlock some additional marriage dialogue!

Portrait mod used in screenshots: [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/modpacks/8013-diverse-stardew-valley]Diverse Stardew Valley Seasonal[/url]
